ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from eligible residents of Meghalaya possessing the requisite
qualifications and experience as mentioned hereafter for engagement to the posts of District
Programme Assistant (DPA) under the District Project Management Unit (DPMU) and Block
Programme Assistant (BPA) for Siju C&RD Block under Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen (SBM-
G), South Garo Hills District, on a contractual basis for a period of one (1) year, extendable subject
to satisfactory performance and continuation of the programme.
The applicants should submit their applications in standard form along with self-attested
photocopies of their Bio-data and testimonials, educational qualification certificates, experience
certificates (if any), one (1) recent passport-size photograph and contact details to the Office of the
District Rural Development Agency (DRDA), South Garo Hills District, Baghmara, on or before 30 th
November, 2026. Applications received after the stipulated date will not be entertained.
Eligible candidates shall be required to appear for a Screening Test and/or Computer Skill Test, as
applicable, for the respective posts. The date and venue of the tests shall be notified separately.
Shortlisted candidates will subsequently be called for Personal Interview.
No TA/DA will be entertained for candidates appearing for the Screening Test, Computer
Skill Test and Personal Interview.
